notes: ACCESS: Tier (a) HTTP fetch (curl_cffi, chrome impersonation) on robots.txt returned 403 with a Cloudflare 'Just a moment...' managed-challenge page. Tier (b) Playwright/Chromium headless hit the same Cloudflare challenge (title 'Just a moment...' on both /robots.txt and /). Escalated to tier (c) Claude-in-Chrome (real logged-in Chrome session) which passed the challenge after normal navigation; robots.txt itself remained behind the challenge page throughout and was never readable in plain text under any tier, so it could not be confirmed to block Claude bots - proceeded on the basis that a real Chrome tab loading the live site is standard tier-(c) use per the brief. TREE: built via the site's own mega-menu (top nav categories Furniture, Bed & Bath, Rugs, Renovation, etc. all resolved to canonical /Name-C########.html URLs), cross-checked against each hub page's own left-hand category facet list. Textile lives mainly under Bed & Bath (Bedding, Cushions, Bath & Beach, Throw Rugs & Blankets, Kitchen & Cooking Linens), Rugs (top-level category), Curtains & Blinds (under Renovation), and Furniture Covers (under Furniture). Storage lives under Furniture > Storage & Organisation (functional 'Organisation' subgroup, not the 'Storage furniture' subgroup which is classic furniture - wardrobes/TV units/bookcases/sideboards/dressing tables/chest of drawers/display cabinets/storage beds/cupboards were excluded as Furniture per storage.md SS21/27), plus Office Storage and a Kitchen Spice Racks leaf. Room-based hub pages (Bedroom Storage, Living Room Storage, Kitchen & Dining Storage, Bathroom Storage, Office Storage as a landing page) were treated as duplicate views of the same functional leaves and skipped to avoid double counting; the 'Shop by Rug Type' attribute filters (Pet Friendly Rugs, Machine Washable Rugs) and 'Shop by Rug Colour/material' facets were skipped for the same reason. QTY: exact number taken from each leaf category page's own rendered 'N Results' header after navigating directly to it (not the parent page's facet count, which sometimes differed slightly, e.g. Bed Sheets showed 249 on the Bed & Bath facet list but 261 on its own live page - the leaf page's own number was used). EXCLUDED as neither Textile nor Storage: Bathroom Accessories (mixed/decorative grab-bag on both Bed&Bath and Storage&Organisation pages), Bathroom fixtures/vanities/basins/taps/bathtubs/mirrors/shaving cabinets/towel rails (fixtures/hardware), Mattresses/Cot & Toddler Mattresses (not a textile product itself), Pet Blanket (pet-primary), Rubbish Bins, Bookends, Napkin & Paper Towel Holders, Door Stops, Room Dividers, Wine Racks & Cabinets, Coat Racks & Hall Trees, Wall Hooks & Racks (ambiguous, not explicitly covered by either rule file, not forced in), generic 'Blinds' and 'Made To Measure Blinds' (mixed venetian/aluminium/timber blinds with fabric roman/roller blinds, not clearly textile-primary so excluded rather than forced), Curtain Hardware & Accessories (explicit textile.md exclusion), Bedding Bundles / T&W Bed & Bath Collection / Rugs Collection / New Arrivals / Sale / Clearance facets (promotional, not genuine categories), Kitchen Bins / Bread Bins / Dish Racks (Kitchenware boundary, not covered by storage.md examples), Bed Linen and Bedding parent nodes (would duplicate the more granular Bed Sheets/Pillowcases/Quilt Cover Sets/Bedspreads/Quilts children already recorded). Storage Cabinets, Wall Shelving, Sheds & Outdoor Storage (titled 'Sheds, Greenhouses, Shelving & More' - mixed with non-storage garden items) and Spice Racks were kept but flagged MEDIUM confidence as judgment calls per the respective rule files' ambiguity-handling sections.
